# James Connolly

> Final-year BSc Computer Systems student at the University of Limerick (First Class Honours standing, graduating May 2027). Most recently a Software Engineering Intern at Microsoft Azure Core; before that a Junior Developer at Deloitte. Works on release engineering, CI/CD, build optimisation and test automation. Looking for graduate roles in software and site reliability engineering.

## Experience

- **Software Engineering Intern, Microsoft Azure Core, Dublin (Jun 2026 - Sep 2026).** Built an end-to-end release orchestration agent that brings approvals, pipeline queues and production compliance checks into one place, replacing a release workflow spread across about 15 tabs and bookmarks, with every required gate checked before code reaches production. Profiled CI bottlenecks and added targeted build caching, cutting build runtimes by up to 33% and saving 80+ hours of developer time per week.
- **Junior Developer, Deloitte, Public Sector & Enterprise Solutions, Dublin (May 2025 - Feb 2026).** Started test automation for the team with a Playwright regression framework of 400+ end-to-end tests. Each test runs in about 3 minutes and replaces 20-40 minutes of manual testing, saving an estimated 130+ hours per full regression cycle. Deloitte formed a dedicated Test Automation team after the placement to take the framework forward. Also built full-stack features in C#, JavaScript, Blazor, KnockoutJS and CSS with SQL Server (SSMS), Redis and Azure DevOps, in an Agile Scrum team. Selected attendee of the Deloitte Future Leaders Academy and student brand representative for Deloitte at the University of Limerick Careers Fair.
- **Research & Software Development Intern, Biocomputing and Development Systems Group, University of Limerick (May 2024 - Aug 2024).** Built an R/Shiny app for exploring biological and medical datasets; a predictive pre-loading design cut view load times by 38%. Gave weekly technical research presentations to senior researchers. Live app: https://jamesconnolly.shinyapps.io/main_research/ Code: https://github.com/Jamco04/Summer-Internship-Project
